description: This file implements functions and operators related to QUIC acknowledgment frames, including the QuicAckFrame class, PacketNumberQueue class, and associated utility functions for handling ACK frames in the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicAckFrame
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment frame in QUIC, containing information about acknowledged packets, delays, and ECN counters.

classes.name: PacketNumberQueue
classes.description: Manages a collection of packet number intervals for tracking received packets efficiently.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if a packet is awaiting acknowledgment based on the ACK frame and packet numbers.

methods.name: QuicAckFrame::Clear
methods.description: Resets the ACK frame's data to default state.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::Add
methods.description: Adds a packet number to the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::AddRange
methods.description: Adds a range of packet numbers to the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::RemoveUpTo
methods.description: Removes packet numbers up to a specified value.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::RemoveSmallestInterval
methods.description: Removes the smallest interval of packet numbers.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a packet number is in the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::Empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::Min
methods.description: Returns the smallest packet number in the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::Max
methods.description: Returns the largest packet number in the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::NumPacketsSlow
methods.description: Calculates the total number of packets in the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::NumIntervals
methods.description: Returns the number of intervals in the queue.

methods.name: PacketNumberQueue::LastIntervalLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the last interval.
